title: .NET parallels: DI, EF Core, middleware, LINQ N+1

preview.what: Your .NET year mapped to Laravel: DI, EF Core, middleware, LINQ's own N+1.
preview.picture: The same restaurant with different signage — once you see the mapping, both stacks stay alive in interviews.
preview.why: Lets you answer 'how is Laravel different from ASP.NET Core?' with substance.
preview.bn: একই restaurant, আলাদা সাইনবোর্ড — mapping দেখলে দুই stack-ই interview-এ জীবন্ত থাকে।
